description: This is a unit test class for the Features class, specifically testing the immutable variant ImmutableFeatures. It verifies behaviors such as equality, immutability, JSON serialization, feature management (adding, removing, setting features and their properties), and builder correctness within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableFeatures, verifying its immutability, feature management, serialization, and builder operations within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Features instance underTest before each test method execution.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods of ImmutableFeatures using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFeatures instances are immutable and that their internal features are also immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Ensures that creating ImmutableFeatures with null features throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyFeaturesIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that the empty Features instance reports being empty and of size zero.

methods.name: jsonSerializationWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON string output of ImmutableFeatures matches the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: tryToGetFeatureWithNullId
methods.description: Checks that getting a feature with null ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getExistingFeatureReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that requesting an existing feature returns the correct feature wrapped in an Optional.

methods.name: getNonExistingFeatureReturnsEmptyOptional
methods.description: Checks that requesting a non-existent feature returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: tryToSettNullFeature
methods.description: Verifies that setting a null feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setSameFeatureAgainReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Ensures that setting the same feature (by ID) does not change the Features object.

methods.name: setFeatureReplacesPreviousFeatureWithSameId
methods.description: Tests that setting a feature with an existing ID replaces the old feature.

methods.name: setFeatureToEmptyFeaturesWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that adding a feature to an empty Features instance results in a Features containing only that feature.

methods.name: tryToRemoveFeatureWithNullId
methods.description: Verifies that removing a feature with null ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: removingNonExistentFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Checks that removing a non-existent feature does not alter the Features object.

methods.name: removeFeatureWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that removing an existing feature results in an empty Features collection.

methods.name: tryToSetNullDefinition
methods.description: Ensures that setting a null feature definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setDefinitionOnEmptyFeaturesCreatesFeatureWithDefinition
methods.description: Tests that setting a definition on empty Features creates a new feature with that definition.

methods.name: setDefinitionToFeature
methods.description: Verifies that setting a definition on an existing feature updates it appropriately.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromUnknownFeatureDoesNothing
methods.description: Checks that attempting to remove a definition from an unknown feature leaves the Features unchanged.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromKnownFeatureWithDefinition
methods.description: Tests removing a definition from a feature that has one, expecting it to be removed.

methods.name: removeDefinitionFromKnownFeatureWithoutDefinition
methods.description: Verifies that removing a definition from a feature lacking one leaves it unchanged.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertiesWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that setting properties with null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullProperties
methods.description: Ensures that setting null properties on a feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: setSameExistingPropertiesReturnsSameFeatures
methods.description: Tests that setting the same properties again results in the same Features object.

methods.name: setPropertiesOverwritesExistingProperties
methods.description: Verifies that setting properties updates the feature with new properties.

methods.name: setPropertiesToFeatureWithoutProperties
methods.description: Checks that setting properties on a feature without existing properties creates a new feature with those properties.

methods.name: setPropertiesOnEmptyFeaturesCreatesNewFeatureWithProperties
methods.description: Verifies creating a new feature with properties on an empty Features collection.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures toJson produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertiesForNullFeatureId
methods.description: Checks that removing properties with null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: removePropertiesFromNonExistingFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Verifies that removing properties from a non-existing feature does not alter the Features object.

methods.name: removePropertiesFromExistingFeatureWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that removing properties from an existing feature results in a feature with empty properties.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Verifies that setting a property with null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that setting a property with null JSON pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetPropertyWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that setting a property with null value throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: doNotSetPropertyIfItIsAlreadySet
methods.description: Verifies that setting a property to the same value does not create a new Features instance.

methods.name: overwriteExistingPropertyValue
methods.description: Tests that setting a property with a different value updates the feature.

methods.name: setNonExistingPropertyValue
methods.description: Checks that setting a property on a non-existing feature adds the property.

methods.name: setPropertyToNonExistingFeature
methods.description: Verifies that setting a property on a non-existent feature creates it.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertyWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that removing a property with null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToRemovePropertyWithNullJsonPointer
methods.description: Checks that removing a property with null JSON pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: removePropertyFromNonExistingFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Verifies that removing a property from a non-existent feature does nothing.

methods.name: removeNonExistingPropertyFromExistingFeatureReturnsSameFeaturesObject
methods.description: Checks that removing a non-existent property returns the same Features object.

methods.name: removeExistingPropertyFromExistingFeatureWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that removing an existing property clears it from the feature.

methods.name: ensureFeaturesNewBuilderWorks
methods.description: Verifies that a new Features builder creates an equivalent Features object.

methods.name: ensureFeaturesToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Tests that toBuilder creates a builder that produces an equivalent Features object.
